scope: Fresh independent audit of the observed M772/M533 r14 exact-command rc=1 and Traceback ending in RuntimeError('M770 launch boundary'). The audit is read-only with respect to all pre-existing artifacts and executes no runner, VCS, simv, license query, HDL/EDA tool, CPU/GPU experiment, or remote job. Only this review package and its mechanical seals are new.

observed_trigger.note: The console failure supplied to this audit is not promoted to a citable functional receipt. The exact mismatch and control-flow boundary are independently reproducible from the sealed runner and M770 JSON without executing the runner.

root_cause.causal_statement: The sealed M770 decision object has r14_launch_authorized_now=false and no vcs_launch_authorized_now key. Python dict.get therefore returns None, and the runner's `is False` predicate deterministically raises before the first preflight temporary directory or atomic result publication.

m779_gap_assessment.why_missed: The final hammer validated the intended M770 boundary using the correct r14_launch_authorized_now key, but did not extract and validate the runner heredoc's actual key reference. Thus the hammer and runner implemented different predicates while all file hashes still matched.
m779_gap_assessment.p0_reason: No P0 is assigned because the runner failed closed before any result, live license query, HDL compile, simulation, or claim-bearing receipt was created.

r14_release_disposition.distinction: An unconsumed atomic attempt does not make the defective exact release reusable. The one released command has already demonstrated a deterministic pre-mkdir blocker; changing it changes the runner identity and requires a fresh additive release chain.

authorized_executable_delta: Replace the erroneous runner lookup of decision.vcs_launch_authorized_now with the sealed M770 field decision.r14_launch_authorized_now.
Use additive r15 identities and update only identity-bound hashes and paths required by that successor chain.
mandatory_fresh_gates: Fresh source hammer must parse or exactly mirror every executable embedded JSON predicate, including validation that each referenced key exists in its bound JSON schema.
Fresh candidate hammer, launch_now=true release, and final-release hammer are required before any VCS, simv, live license query, or result mkdir.
Fresh final hammer must include a negative test that renaming or deleting decision.r14_launch_authorized_now fails the same predicate used by the runner.
All runner require_regular_sha edges must be re-enumerated and live-matched after additive identity rebinding.
forbidden: Editing, deleting, resealing, rerunning, relabeling, or citing the r14 release chain as a successful attempt.
Any RTL, TB, SVA, macro adapter, foundry model, UNIT_DELAY, protocol, coverage, watchdog, resource, collision, timing-bypass, or claim-boundary relaxation.
Any statement that r14 reached VCS compile, simv, functional verification, timing verification, PPA, energy, cycles, speedup, full-network, or system evidence.

finding.title: M779 authorized a runner whose embedded M770 key did not exist
finding.closure: Close only through a new additive r15 source and a fresh independent chain that validates the runner's executable predicate rather than an intended mirror.

decision.required_next_gate: Author one additive r15 source package with only the exact M770 key fix and new identity bindings, then obtain fresh source/candidate/release/final hammers before any run.
